preguntas.respuesta: HomeTest is a preventive-health membership. It includes blood tests covering 110+ biomarkers twice a year, an app that explains your results and connects them with your wearable data, and verified professionals who help you take action with a plan made for you.

No. Our results are information for you and to share with a healthcare professional, not a medical diagnosis. We give you clear signals and recommendations so your conversation with your doctor is better informed, but clinical assessment and any medical decision always belong to a professional.

preguntas.pregunta: What does the blood test include?
preguntas.respuesta: A panel of 110+ blood and urine biomarkers, grouped by body system: metabolism, lipids and heart, hormones, thyroid, nutrients and vitamins, blood count, immune system and inflammation, liver, kidney and more. You can see the full list on the biomarkers page.

preguntas.pregunta: How often do I get tested?
preguntas.respuesta: Twice a year. The first test sets your baseline; the second, six months later, shows how your markers have changed and is used to adjust your plan.

preguntas.pregunta: Can I upload blood tests I already have?
preguntas.respuesta: Yes. Upload the PDF or a photo of your blood test and the app extracts the results for you. You review them before saving and they become part of your history.
You'll be able to get tested at a partner lab near you, booking from the app. For some specific tests you'll also be able to collect the sample at home with a kit.
